agent.title: Bundled agent
agent.description: Discord Assist can be its own conversation agent, calling an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint. Tools come from Home Assistant LLM APIs (for example Assist, or ha-mcp's in-process server) and every call passes through the tool gate: dangerous tools such as restart, backup, file and shell tools are refused unless an owner user explicitly lists them.

data.agent_owner_tools: Owner tools (dangerous tools allowed for owner users)
data.agent_confirm_tools: Tools that require approval (a tool name, or domain: followed by a domain)

data_description.agent_base_url: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, for example http://localhost:1234/v1. Chat completions are posted to the base URL plus /chat/completions.
data_description.agent_api_key: Stored in the entry's data, never in its options. Leave blank to keep the current key.
data_description.agent_llm_apis: APIs whose tools the agent may use. The built-in Assist API runs as the speaker's Home Assistant user. ha-mcp's API runs as ha-mcp's administrator account; the tool gate is the boundary for it. An empty list means no tools.
data_description.agent_allowed_tools: When set, the model only ever sees these tools and nothing else can run.
data_description.agent_owner_tools: Dangerous tools (restart, backups, file or shell access) stay refused for everyone unless named here, and even then only owner users may use them.
data_description.agent_confirm_tools: Matching calls are refused until Discord approval buttons are available; listing a tool here keeps it off until then.

data.idle_minutes: Reset a conversation after this many idle minutes
data.allowlist: Allowed Discord user IDs (act as the fallback user; mapped users are always allowed)
data.fallback_ha_user: Fallback Home Assistant user for unmapped Discord users
data.speaker_context: Tell the agent who is speaking, from which channel, and the local time
data.prefer_local: Try Home Assistant's built-in commands first, then the agent
data.agent_timeout: Give up on the agent after this many seconds

add_room.title: Room channel
add_room.description: Pick a device in the room this channel stands for (any device in that area works). Requests in the channel and its threads then default to that room, like a voice satellite.

abort.no_rooms: No channels are mapped to rooms.

no_authorized_users.title: Nobody can use {entry_title}
no_authorized_users.description: Discord Assist only answers Discord users it can run as a Home Assistant user. Open the integration options and add a Discord-to-Home-Assistant user mapping, or set allowed Discord user IDs plus a fallback Home Assistant user. Until then the bot ignores every message.

message_content_intent.title: {entry_title} needs the Message Content intent
message_content_intent.description: Discord refused the gateway connection because the bot does not have the Message Content privileged intent. Enable it under Bot > Privileged Gateway Intents in the Discord Developer Portal, then reload the integration.
